name: Myoblast proliferation, migration and differentiation control
rationale: All members concern myoblast proliferation, migration, fate commitment, fusion or differentiation; unlike the confusables (positive differentiation/fusion, satellite cells, general myogenesis) the theme centres on myoblast proliferation, migration and restraint of differentiation.

qualifier: sister chromatid cohesion and metaphase-anaphase control
name: Meiotic chromatid cohesion and metaphase-anaphase segregation control
rationale: Members cover meiotic cohesion, chiasmata, chromosome alignment, checkpoint and the metaphase/anaphase transition, whereas confusables cover prophase recombination/synapsis, G2/MI regulation or spindle positioning and polar body extrusion.

qualifier: Rap1 and Rho GTPase effectors driving spreading and stress fibres
name: Integrin-Rap1 and Rho signalling driving cell spreading
rationale: All members are integrin-coupled signalling events (Rap1, ROCK/PAK, IPP complex, Cas/GRB2-SOS linkage) producing stress fibres and cell spreading, unlike confusables centred on platelet activation, shear stress, fibronectin matrix or fibroblast migration.

qualifier: TLR, TNF and NF-kB with IL-6/IL-1b/TNF output
name: Suppression of TLR-TNF-NF-kB signalling and inflammatory cytokines
rationale: Every member negatively regulates TLR2/4, LPS, TNF or NF-kB signalling or downstream proinflammatory cytokine production, while confusables add IL-10/IL-12 regulation, inflammasome activation or positive TLR signalling.

qualifier: TLR-NF-kB plus T-cell cytokines, mostly inhibitory
name: Regulation of TLR-NF-kB and T-cell cytokine responses, largely inhibitory
rationale: Members are predominantly negative regulators of TLR/NF-kB/TNF signalling and of IL-1/6/8/12 and T-cell (IL-2, IL-21, Th1) cytokines plus IL-10/IL-37 anti-inflammatory signals, distinguishing it from confusables that activate NF-kB, TLR or inflammasomes or regulate only T-cell activation.

qualifier: ribosomal subunit and HIV Rev cargo
name: Nuclear pore trafficking of ribosomal subunits and viral RNA
rationale: Members are nuclear pore complex components and the cargo they move (ribosomal subunit export, Rev import and HIV RNA export, periphery gene tethering), whereas confusables cover NPC assembly/disassembly, generic protein import/export regulation or inositol phosphate transport.

name: Sarcomeric actomyosin assembly and striated muscle contraction
rationale: All members concern thick/thin filament assembly, actin-myosin sliding and contraction of striated muscle, unlike confusables about costameres, desmosomes, muscle growth or adaptation.

name: Kainate/AMPA receptor activation and Gbg presynaptic inhibition
rationale: Members combine ionotropic kainate/AMPA receptor activation with G-beta-gamma-mediated GIRK activation, Ca channel inhibition and extrasynaptic GABA tuning of presynaptic potential, distinct from confusables on inhibitory synapse assembly, vesicle exocytosis or nicotinic receptors.

name: Centrosomal microtubule nucleation, anchoring and tubulin glutamylation
rationale: Members cover MTOC nucleation/anchoring, centrosome positioning, microtubule stability and tubulin C-terminal (de)glutamylation and severing; the glutamylation/severing content separates it from confusables on spindle orientation, centriole duplication and cilia.

qualifier: nucleotide excision and error-free POLH bypass
name: UV lesion nucleotide excision repair and error-free POLH bypass
rationale: All members address UV photolesion repair through GG-/TC-NER recognition and incision or POLH error-free translesion synthesis, whereas confusables emphasise gap filling, base excision repair, replication or error-prone TLS.

core: Cell adhesion junctions and matrix attachment
name: Cadherin, desmosome and hemidesmosome-basement membrane adhesion
rationale: Members span cadherin/desmosome cell-cell adhesion and hemidesmosome, laminin, collagen and integrin anchorage to basement membrane, distinct from confusables focused on adherens/apical junctions, polarity and EMT or cornified envelope.

qualifier: NRF2 and HIF control of glycolysis and redox
name: NRF2- and HIF-driven glycolytic and redox metabolic reprogramming
rationale: Members are NRF2 target programmes, HIF hypoxia signalling and glycolytic/PPP/NADP regulation (with p53 and mTORC1 metabolic signatures), unlike confusables built on AKT-FOXO signalling or ROS/ferroptosis and NADPH regeneration.

name: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism and inborn organic acidurias
rationale: Members are leucine, valine and isoleucine catabolism and the enzyme deficiencies of these pathways, whereas confusables concern threonine, choline, carnitine or biotin metabolism.

name: RUNX1-driven erythroid, megakaryocytic and granulocytic haematopoietic differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC maintenance and erythroid, megakaryocyte and granulocyte lineage commitment with extensive RUNX1 transcriptional control, while confusables centre on M-CSF/macrophage signalling or bone marrow niche proliferation.

name: Visual retinoid cycle and its inherited retinal defects
rationale: Members are retinol/retinal metabolism in the rod and cone visual cycle and its ABCA4, LRAT, RDH, STRA6 defects and A2E formation, unlike confusables on opsin phototransduction or retinoic acid metabolism.

name: Leucine catabolism and branched-chain organic acidurias
rationale: Members are leucine catabolism and the organic acidurias of its enzymes (isovaleric acidaemia, 3-MCC, 3-methylglutaconic aciduria) plus beta-ketothiolase deficiency, lacking the valine, short-chain fatty acid and biotin content of the confusables.

core: Coagulation factor VIII and IX defects
name: Factor VIII and IX variant defects in intrinsic tenase
rationale: Every member is a defective F8 or F9 variant affecting tenase function, distinguishing it from confusables on VWF, FXII/kallikrein, FV or general coagulation and fibrinolysis.

name: Spermatid axoneme, manchette and mitochondrial sheath assembly
rationale: Members build spermatid structures (axoneme, central apparatus, manchette, mitochondrial sheath) with Sertoli barrier support, unlike confusables on sperm motility regulation, tubulin modification or motile cilia dynein arms.

qualifier: protein import, quality control and dynamics
name: Mitochondrial protein import, quality control and dynamics
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial protein targeting, import, processing and degradation, cristae formation, fission/fusion, calcium uptake and PINK1-PRKN mitophagy, whereas confusables are general autophagy/autophagosome or lack the import machinery.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling and heart rate
name: Calcium-cycling control of cardiac contraction, relaxation and heart rate
rationale: Members regulate cardiac force, relaxation and rate through SR calcium uptake/release and Ca-ATPase activity, unlike confusables on gap-junction conduction, store-operated entry or skeletal ryanodine release.

name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching
rationale: Members cover intermediate mesoderm, nephric/mesonephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching, whereas confusables concern metanephric mesenchyme, nephron segment patterning and kidney growth control.

name: Hox gene cluster co-expression
rationale: All six members are Hox gene cluster expression modules, distinct from confusables on hindbrain HOX activation, neural plate, somitogenesis or RUNX1 transcription.

name: Double-strand break sensing, NHEJ-HR choice and PARP ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing, ATM recruitment, classical/alternative NHEJ, regulation of HR versus NHEJ and PARP ADP-ribosylation cycles, unlike confusables on BRCA-dependent HR defects, chromatin assembly or replication stress.

core: B cell activation and plasma cell differentiation
name: Tfh-helped B cell proliferation and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover B cell proliferation, germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation with Tfh differentiation and ICOS co-stimulation, unlike confusables dominated by memory/naive B cell signatures and B cell homeostasis.

name: Zinc transport and MTF1-metallothionein heavy-metal response
rationale: Members are SLC30/SLC39 zinc transport and deficiency plus MTF1/metallothionein responses to zinc, cadmium, copper and mercury, distinguishing it from confusables on copper, manganese and iron handling.
